root: ^You step into the Chief Resident's office. Dr. Santos is reviewing your patient files. She sighs and gestures for you to sit. Her expression is stern.
^"Have a seat, Doctor. We need to discuss your overall performance."
^"While I see your dedication, your clinical evaluations show critical gaps—particularly in patient safety and information gathering."
^"I understand. Some of the atypical cases and red flags caught me off guard."
^"In primary care, missing a warning sign or failing to educate a patient on home care can be fatal. We cannot compromise on the standard of care."
^"I need you to return to the Medical Archive. Review the Clinical Practice Guidelines for Dengue, Gastroenteritis, and Hypertension."
^"Once you are ready, you will need to repeat these clinical rotations."
^Your residency evaluation requires improvement. Review the Case Library and try again.
